column1: # Zork I runtime excerpts, in route order. No entries in runtime vocabulary contain sentences.

column2: There is a small mailbox here.
There is no door here, and all the windows are boarded up.
column3: Здесь нет двери, и все окна заколочены.

column2: To the north a narrow path winds through the trees.
column3: На север узкая тропинка вьётся через деревья.

column2: A path leads into the forest to the east.
column3: Тропинка ведёт в лес на восток.

column2: A bottle is sitting on the table.
Above the trophy case hangs an elvish sword of great antiquity.
column3: Над витриной висит эльфийский меч великой античности.
